t: You're looking at Thomas More Chambers, a building in Camden that takes its name from Sir Thomas More. He was a lawyer, a statesman and a Renaissance humanist, Lord Chancellor to Henry the Eighth, and the author of Utopia. The building was designed by the architect George Campbell Sherrin, who also worked on railway buildings such as Moorgate station and on Old Spitalfields Market. It was commissioned by George Matthews Arnold, a solicitor who became Mayor of Gravesend.
